<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1443
Claimant:
Sarah Porter
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
4-1-25
Claim opened after a report of a minor collision in a parking lot. The claimant, who is not represented by counsel,
reported neck pain and was advised to seek medical attention.
4-14-25
Spoke with the claimant by phone. Their account of the impact was consistent with the initial report, and they
described the vehicle as having been stopped when the other car reversed into it.
6-13-25
The police report confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the collision. The responding officer recorded
the location and the position of both cars.
6-30-25
Reviewed the photographs submitted by the claimant. They show damage to the rear bumper and tail light area,
which is mostly in line with the impact described. No independent witnesses have come forward.
7-20-25
Confirmed with the insured that the driver involved is named on the policy and that coverage was in force at the time
of loss. Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the policy start.
7-24-25
Obtained the vehicle's prior claim and repair history. No earlier damage to the vehicle is recorded, and the repair
esitmate has been scheduled for review.
7-26-25
The claimant's medical records show initial treatment with a physician, followed by a usual course of physiotherapy.
The reported injury fits the kind and force of the collision.
7-30-25
Checked the claimant's history for any prior neck or upper back complaints. None is known, and the claimant has told
the same account in every conversation so far.
8-3-25
Follow-up call with the claimant. Symptoms have eased steadily, and the treatment plan is winding down as they
recover.
10-3-25
Reviewed the file as a whole. The claim is progressing as expected, with the medical treatment tapering as recovery
continues, and the repair estimate is pending final sign-off.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
